k:場.mnemonic: Soil (土) at dawn (旦) with streamers (勿) flying. Somebody marked out the ground with flags at dawn: this is the location for the event. Location (place).
k:場.hint: Flags on the ground at dawn.

k:士.mnemonic: A figure like soil (土) but with the top line longer: a warrior standing wide-shouldered. Samurai (gentleman, scholar).

k:売.mnemonic: A samurai (士) with a forehead (冖) and legs (儿): he has lost his sword and is running around trying to sell it. Sell.

k:言.mnemonic: A mouth (口) with lines of sound rising out of it. Say (word).

k:京.mnemonic: A tall building with a lid on top, a mouth (口) window and a small (小) base. Grand buildings like this are in the capital. Capital.

k:金.mnemonic: A hat over a king (王) with two nuggets at his feet. Under the hat the king hides his gold. Gold (money, metal).
k:金.hint: King hiding gold under a hat.

k:戸.mnemonic: A single door, hinged at the top left, seen from the front. Door.

k:所.mnemonic: A door (戸) and an axe (斤). Where you leave your axe by the door is your place. Place.

k:主.mnemonic: A drop (丶) of flame above a king (王): the king holds up the lamp and is master of the house. Master (lord, main).

k:父.mnemonic: A figure holding a stone axe in each hand, crossed: the one who does the heavy work. Father.

k:交.mnemonic: A lid (亠) over a father (父). Under the lid the fathers' legs cross and mingle. Mingle (intersect, exchange).

k:体.mnemonic: A leader (亻) with a book (本). The leader's whole body is in the book, its origin. Body.
k:体.hint: Leader with the body of the book.

k:校.mnemonic: A tree (木) where people mingle (交). The tree everyone meets under is at the school. School.

k:県.mnemonic: An eye (目) looking down on something small (小). From the top of the hill everything below is small: that is your whole prefecture. Prefecture.

k:水.mnemonic: A stream running down the middle with splashes to each side. Water.

k:家.mnemonic: A pig (豕) under a roof (宀). In old farmhouses the pig lived under the same roof. House (home, family).

k:男.mnemonic: Power (力) in the rice field (田). The one using his strength in the field is the man.

k:当.mnemonic: Sparkles (⺌) over a broom (ヨ). When the broom sparkles it has been used just the appropriate amount. Appropriate (hit, this, correct).

k:開.mnemonic: A gate (門) with a bar (three) across it and twenty (廾) hands lifting the bar. Open.
k:開.hint: Hands lifting the bar off a gate.

k:十.mnemonic: A cross: two lines, like two hands crossed to show all ten fingers. Ten.

k:定.mnemonic: A bolt (疋) of cloth under a roof (宀). Once the cloth is under the roof the deal is determined. Determine (fix, decide).

k:部.mnemonic: Stand (立) with a mouth (口) in front of a borough (阝). Each borough that speaks up gets its own section. Section (department).
k:部.hint: Speaker in front of a borough.

k:牛.mnemonic: A cow's head from the front: two horns (one stroke shorter), the face, and the line down the nose. Cow.

k:物.mnemonic: A cow (牛) with streamers (勿) tied to it. Decorate a cow with streamers and it is a thing to look at. Thing (object).

k:公.mnemonic: Fins (ハ) over a cocoon (厶). Open the cocoon and let the fins out: what was private is now public. Public.
